parameters.name: DatasetId
parameters.description: The dataset ID. You can call [ListDatasets](~~457222~~) to obtain the dataset ID.

parameters.name: VersionName
parameters.description: The dataset version name. The version number must be later than v1. Version v1 can only be deleted when the dataset is deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace delete-dataset-version --dataset-id d-lfd60v0p0000ujtsdx --version-name v2 --region cn-hangzhou
